topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I never thought I'd see the day when my own flesh and blood would sit before that man, pen scrawling across paper just as I once did. That strict instructor never held back his tongue, or his stick. My back still aches at the memory of his lessons. Yet, here we are, the wheel turning full circle. I look at my child, so eager, so trusting, and I wonder how I can shield what’s mine from the flail of his words, the shadow of his stern gaze. The harvest may change, but some things, it seems, are stubborn as an unplowed field.
